description:
Source RevMan 5 project file, R analysis pipeline, review prompt, orchestration script, model versions and access dates, and the unedited outputs of the open-weight review panel (DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3-235B, Llama-3.1-70B) and two Gemini cold reads, for a test of archived systematic review data applied to the benzodiazepine-versus-pregabalin comparison of an abandoned Cochrane review (CD001846). A Grok cold read was run interactively and was not retained; the gap is documented in reviewer_outputs/README.md.

Version 1.2.3 adds the Research in Brief prepared for Research Synthesis Methods (manuscripts/Gale_RSM_ResearchInBrief.docx), condensed and revised from the original, longer reference version (paper_reference_version.docx, deposited in v1.1.1, September 2026). Where the two differ in attributing findings to particular models, the Research in Brief has been checked against the archived outputs and should be preferred.

Code (R/, *.py) is released under the MIT licence; data (data/), model outputs (reviewer_outputs/) and manuscripts under CC-BY 4.0.
